Winneradspy is an ad intelligence tool built specifically for mobile apps and games. It tracks competitor ad creatives in real time, scores each one Winner or Loser using AI, and gives you a detailed breakdown of why each creative performs the way it does, covering hook, visuals, emotions, messaging, and CTA.
